mensaje_tutorial_1: Welcome to ComunicELA. First, select a camera and a voice
mensaje_tutorial_2: Next, calibrate blinking to start using the application
mensaje_tutorial_3: You can then use the communication boards
mensaje_tutorial_4: If you are not satisfied with the application's performance, retrain the model to adapt it to your profile.
mensaje_calibracion_1:
Place the camera at the user's eye level and 50–60 cm away

Position the circle inside the centre point of the face
mensaje_calibracion_2: While the user looks at the yellow dot, press Continue
mensaje_calibracion_3:
While the user keeps their eyes closed,

press Continue again
mensaje_calibracion_4: Calibration complete. Press Continue to return to the main menu
instruccion_re1: Retraining adapts the software to the current user
instruccion_re2: The user must follow the red dot with their eyes until the process is complete
instruccion_re3: If the user changes, discard the previous retraining
instruccion_re4: More than one retraining session may overfit the model without improving performance
instruccion_re5: If accuracy decreases, discard the retraining
error_recop_ree: Error collecting retraining data. Please try again
instruccion_tab1: The cursor moves in the direction of your gaze
instruccion_tab2: Keep the cursor over a cell to lock it
instruccion_tab4: Touch the text box to play it
instruccion_tab5: Enable rest mode by closing your eyes for 3 seconds
mensaje_descanso: Rest mode. Keep your eyes closed for 3 seconds to unlock
